context.instruction: Return exactly one JSON object matching output_schema. This is offline geometry evaluation. Use only observations, optional geometry and task. No tools or execution. All positions are object centers in robot_base, meters; orientations are unit quaternions wxyz. For understanding return each question_id once, populating only the relevant answer field: relation=less/equal/greater along the specified positive axis, scalar_m=height/gap, vector_m=position/size, fits=fit; all other fields null. For placement waypoints_m must be empty. For path, waypoints_m excludes start, includes the final position_m, and orientation is fixed throughout translation. Choose any constraint-valid solution.

coordinate_system.pose: object center xyz in meters; unit quaternion wxyz, object local axes in robot_base

task.instruction: The red cuboid is target; the blue cuboid is other. Gray solids are obstacles. Green outlines mark task regions and are visual annotations, not solids. Frame robot_base coincides with the simulation world; +x forward, +y left, +z up. These are static geometric tasks, with no robot reachability or support requirement. Task-defined regions: task_volume: center [0.7, 0.2, 0.1] m, local full size [0.2, 0.18, 0.18] m, wxyz [1, 0, 0, 0]. Choose any fully contained placement, avoiding all solids with the specified clearance. Return no waypoints.

front.axes: SAPIEN pose: +x forward,+y left,+z up. Intrinsic: OpenCV +x right,+y down,+z forward.

side.axes: SAPIEN pose: +x forward,+y left,+z up. Intrinsic: OpenCV +x right,+y down,+z forward.

overhead.axes: SAPIEN pose: +x forward,+y left,+z up. Intrinsic: OpenCV +x right,+y down,+z forward.

synchronization.timestamp_semantics: sequential render readback; no physics step between cameras; immutable static actors
